summary: Cloudastructure, Inc. filed an 8-K on July 28, 2026, disclosing two corporate actions. The company amended its Series 2 Convertible Preferred Stock to add a standard antidilution provision and filed a charter amendment effecting a 1-for-30 reverse stock split of its Class A and Class B common stock, effective July 31, 2026. Authorized capital was proportionally reduced from 500 million shares to approximately 16.67 million. Fractional shares are rounded up. This is a capital-structure adjustment, not a strategic transaction. Watch for potential Nasdaq compliance implications, future financing, or additional restructuring.
